---
title: "The Bond Films!"
---

This page foucses on the box-office revenue for the James Bond Films over time. 

::: {#cell-fig-bond-revenue .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")

plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue in MUSD")
plt.show()
```
